barbarian-rage.note: Not in heavy armor; no spells or concentration. Lasts to the end of the barbarian's next turn and is extended by attacking an enemy, forcing a save or a bonus action, up to 10 minutes.

barbarian-brutal-strike.note: Only with Reckless Attack, giving up its advantage on that attack; adds a Brutal Strike effect (Forceful Blow, Hamstring Blow; Staggering and Sundering Blow from 13th level).

barbarian-relentless-rage.note: Dropping to 0 HP while raging: a DC 10 CON save to go to twice the barbarian level in HP instead; the DC goes up by 5 each use and resets on a short or long rest.

barbarian-persistent-rage.note: On rolling initiative: regain all uses of Rage. Rage lasts 10 minutes without being extended.

berserker-frenzy.note: With Reckless Attack, on the first Strength attack hit of the turn.

berserker-intimidating-presence.note: Bonus action: creatures of choice within 30 feet make a WIS save (DC 8 + STR + pb) or are frightened for 1 minute; a use of Rage restores it.

bard-bardic-inspiration.note: Bonus action: a creature within 60 feet gets the "inspired" condition with source "Bardic Inspiration d6" (d8 from 5th level, d10 from 10th, d12 from 15th) for 1 hour, added to one failed D20 test.

bard-font-of-inspiration.note: A spell slot gives back one Bardic Inspiration.

bard-superior-inspiration.note: Rolling initiative with fewer than two Bardic Inspirations brings them back to two.

lore-cutting-words.note: Reaction: spend a Bardic Inspiration to subtract the die from a creature's damage roll or a successful ability check or attack roll.

cleric-channel-divinity.note: Divine Spark (heal, or necrotic or radiant damage with a CON save for half) or Turn Undead (WIS save).

cleric-sear-undead.note: Turn Undead also deals WIS modifier d8s radiant (at least 1d8) to each undead that fails its save.

cleric-blessed-strikes.note: Only with the Divine Strike option; Potent Spellcasting instead adds the WIS modifier to cleric cantrip damage.

cleric-divine-intervention.note: Magic action: cast any cleric spell of level 5 or lower without a slot or material components.

cleric-greater-divine-intervention.note: Divine Intervention can cast Wish; then not again for 2d4 long rests.

life-disciple-of-life.note: Healing from a spell slot heals 2 + the slot's level more.

life-preserve-life.note: Channel Divinity: share out 5 × cleric level HP among bloodied creatures within 30 feet, none above half its HP maximum.

druid-wild-shape.note: A known beast form for half the druid level in hours; temp HP equal to the druid level on changing.

druid-wild-companion.note: Spend a Wild Shape use or a spell slot to cast Find Familiar (a fey spirit that leaves after a long rest).

druid-wild-resurgence.note: Once per turn with no Wild Shape left, a spell slot gives one back. Once per long rest, a Wild Shape use gives a level 1 slot.

druid-elemental-fury.note: Only with the Primal Strike option; Potent Spellcasting instead adds the WIS modifier to druid cantrip damage.

druid-archdruid.note: Rolling initiative with no Wild Shape left gives back one use; Wild Shape uses can become spell slots.

land-circle-of-the-land-spells.note: After each long rest the druid picks arid, polar, temperate or tropical land for extra prepared spells.

land-lands-aid.note: Magic action, one Wild Shape use: a 10-foot sphere within 60 feet; chosen creatures make a CON save, 2d6 necrotic (half on a success), and one creature regains 2d6 HP.

land-natural-recovery.note: After a short rest: recover spell slots with a combined level up to half the druid level (rounded up), none level 6 or higher; or cast one circle spell without a slot.

fighter-tactical-mind.note: On a failed ability check, spend a Second Wind use to add 1d10 (not spent if the check still fails).

fighter-action-surge.note: One more action this turn, not the Magic action (only once on the same turn).

fighter-indomitable.note: Reroll a failed saving throw with the fighter level added.

champion-survivor.note: Advantage on death saves, and 18-20 counts as a 20; bloodied (above 0 HP) at the start of a turn: regain 5 + CON modifier HP.

monk-martial-arts.note: Unarmed strikes and monk weapons can use DEX and the Martial Arts die (d6, d8 from 5th level, d10 from 11th, d12 from 17th); an unarmed strike as a bonus action.

monk-monks-focus.note: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind: 1 point each; save DC 8 + WIS + pb.

monk-uncanny-metabolism.note: On rolling initiative: regain all Focus Points and heal the Martial Arts die + monk level.

monk-stunning-strike.note: Once per turn on a monk weapon or unarmed hit, 1 Focus Point: CON save or stunned until the start of the monk's next turn (a success halves its speed and gives advantage on the next attack against it).

open-hand-wholeness-of-body.note: Bonus action: heal the Martial Arts die + WIS modifier (at least 1).

open-hand-quivering-palm.note: 4 Focus Points on an unarmed hit; later: CON save, 10d12 force on a failure, half on a success.

paladin-lay-on-hands.note: A pool of HP: bonus action, spend any amount to heal that many; 5 points remove the poisoned condition.

paladin-paladins-smite.note: Divine Smite once without a slot: spend "Divine Smite (free)" instead of a spell slot.

paladin-channel-divinity.note: Divine Sense, and the oath's options.

devotion-sacred-weapon.note: Channel Divinity: + CHA modifier to attack rolls with one melee weapon for 10 minutes, and its damage can be radiant.

devotion-holy-nimbus.note: Bonus action, 10 minutes: advantage on saves against fiends and undead, and enemies starting their turn in the aura take CHA modifier + pb radiant; a level 5 slot restores it.

ranger-tireless.note: Magic action: temp HP 1d8 + WIS modifier. A short rest removes one exhaustion level.

ranger-natures-veil.note: Bonus action: invisible until the end of the ranger's next turn.

hunter-hunters-prey.note: Colossus Slayer only against a creature missing HP; Horde Breaker is the other option (one more attack against a creature next to the target).

hunter-defensive-tactics.note: Escape the Horde (opportunity attacks against the ranger have disadvantage) or Multiattack Defense, swappable after each rest.

rogue-sneak-attack.note: Needs advantage on the attack, or an ally within 5 feet of the target (and no disadvantage). From 5th level Cunning Strike trades dice for effects.

rogue-stroke-of-luck.note: Turn a failed D20 test into a 20.

thief-use-magic-device.note: Four attuned items; a 6 on a d6 keeps a used charge; any spell scroll with INT.

sorcerer-innate-sorcery.note: Sorcerer spell save DC +1 for the minute.

sorcerer-font-of-magic.note: Bonus action: 2/3/5/6/7 points for a level 1-5 spell slot (gone after a long rest), or a slot for its level in points.

sorcerer-sorcerous-restoration.note: After a short rest: regain Sorcery Points up to half the sorcerer level (rounded down).

draconic-sorcery-elemental-affinity.note: Resistance to the chosen dragon damage type; spells of that type add the CHA modifier to one damage roll.

draconic-sorcery-dragon-wings.note: Bonus action: fly speed 60 feet for 1 hour; 3 Sorcery Points restore the use.

warlock-magical-cunning.note: 1-minute rite: regain up to half the Pact Magic slots (rounded up; all of them at 20th level).

warlock-mystic-arcanum.note: One spell of each arcanum level (6 at 11th, 7 at 13th, 8 at 15th, 9 at 17th), each cast once without a slot.

fiend-patron-dark-ones-blessing.note: When the warlock or someone within 10 feet brings an enemy to 0 HP: temp HP equal to CHA modifier + warlock level.

fiend-patron-dark-ones-own-luck.note: Add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after seeing the roll, once per roll.

fiend-patron-fiendish-resilience.note: Resistance to one damage type other than force, chosen after each short or long rest.

fiend-patron-hurl-through-hell.note: Once per turn on an attack hit: CHA save against the spell save DC or the target vanishes until the end of the warlock's next turn, takes 8d10 psychic unless it is a fiend, and is incapacitated.

wizard-arcane-recovery.note: After a short rest: recover spell slots with a combined level up to half the wizard level (rounded up), none level 6 or higher.

wizard-memorize-spell.note: After a short rest, swap one prepared level 1+ spell for another from the spellbook.

wizard-spell-mastery.note: One level 1 and one level 2 spell can be cast at their lowest level without a slot.

wizard-signature-spells.note: Two level 3 spells, each cast once at level 3 without a slot between rests.

evoker-overchannel.note: Maximum damage with a wizard spell from a level 1-5 slot. Again before a long rest: 2d12 necrotic per slot level to the wizard (1d12 more each further time), ignoring resistance.
